text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Seeking the Pearl shone as 
a magnificent, oversized pearl, and then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Come, Trainer, we're heading 
abroad this year! Our target, of course, 
is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Prix Maurice de Gheest. The fateful 
race you found for me."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go get it back after a whole year! 
Yes, right now, we can do even better than 
last year—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A crushing victory! Seeking the Pearl 
takes a runaway win! A rocket start turned 
into an astonishing wire-to-wire triumph!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dragged into an unfamiliar, blistering 
pace, the other Umamusume are completely 
collapsing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Just as planned, Trainer! What a 
wonderful race development♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Still... being the second one to conquer 
European GⅠs... The loss of impact is 
significant...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Even so... this is my choice.)

Seeking the Pearl quietly returned home. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? '100 Umamusume Who Made 
History'?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems 100 people will be selected 
via fan voting.

Kawakami Princess, my roommate, told me 
about a project that had been progressing 
at Tracen Academy while I was on my 
overseas campaign.

Apparently, a massive fan poll covering 
every Umamusume in history is going to be 
held.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A hundred... It might sound like a lot at 
first glance, but being chosen is going to 
be incredibly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking all of history, there's 
an absurd number of horse girls. Literally 
as numerous as the stars.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even a pearl wouldn't shine inside 
there... right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And that concludes the announcement of 
the '100 Historic Umamusume.' 
Congratulations to all the nominees!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. Seeking the Pearl-san didn't 
place, huh. And here I thought she just 
might."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Even though she won an overseas G1. Though 
maybe it can't be helped. Because...
(*springs up!*)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... What was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Could this be a prophetic dream, I wonder? 
Well... it will most likely turn out this 
way in reality.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Rather than being the world's first, I 
chose to race against Taiki. To prove 
what's possible.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed. Let us live not in the records, 
but in their memories.)

"And so, the day of the results 
announcement for 'Top 100 Historic 
Umamusume' finally arrived."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us make the announcement. For an 
active Umamusume to be counted among these 
100 individuals is, without a doubt, the 
highest of honors.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Once the chosen Umamusume appears, I hope 
everyone will give her a huge round of 
applause.
And so, the presentations proceeded—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ho, it seems one has been chosen from the 
active roster. The next Umamusume is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle!
(UOOOOOOOOOOOH!?)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... really!? I did it----!!!
(WOOOOAAAHH!!)

A roar of applause envelops Taiki Shuttle. 
Cheers that even eclipse those of a GⅠ 
race.

That was only natural. Everyone understood 
just how valuable this vote was.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, it's only natural from my 
perspective. Taiki is the very first 
Umamusume to conquer a European G1 race, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Congratulations, Taiki... You truly are 
great.)

And the announcements continued. As name 
after name of legendary Umamusume were 
called...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now for the next announcement. But first, 
there is something I must tell everyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"This '100 Legendary Umamusume' isn't just 
about competing over race records. It 
heavily reflects how deeply they moved 
their fans."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"She gave the fans something far beyond 
glory. Those who have accomplished that—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume fans are watching closely. 
...This is undeniable proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will announce the next Umamusume. 
The one chosen is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl! ...Congratulations!
(UOOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh... Huh... Huh...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What... what happened? I... missed out on 
conquering Europe for the first time...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even though I resigned myself to second 
place behind Taiki... Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! You did it, Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was natural that I'd be 
chosen! I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If you're an Umamusume fan, you've just 
GOT to vote for Pearl-san, YES!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Tai... ki...

Even the silver-tongued Seeking the Pearl 
fell silent. Yes, fans all across the 
world were watching.

—To bring courage to people across the 
world. The figure of a seeker who kept 
pushing forward with only that wish in her 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer...... I won't cry...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I... I am the most beautiful, confident, 
and top-grade Pearl of all! So...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't cry! Like I'd ever cry over this!!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, and deliver the greeting with 
dignity!

Yeah, let's make our greeting dignified 
too!

text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl doesn't need empty 
encouragement or comforting. If she's 
dreaming big, you just help her dream even 
bigger. And then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Seeking the Pearl is here! My, 
those fans truly have no eye for 
greatness.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To think people would vote for me when I 
settled for second in conquering a 
European GⅠ. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone! No matter what anyone 
thinks of me, there are things I won't 
compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can forget about me. But what I showed 
you... never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, "everyone holds hidden potential"! 
Every single person in the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Let us keep searching for it. With me! 
Together with me!"

And so, Seeking the Pearl became a 
legendary Umamusume, etched into both 
history and memory.

"This story, too, is yet another 
possibility. The jewel has always been 
within oneself."
